answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a grove as the anchor of the cost.
